name: Telegram
description: Cloud-based instant messaging and voice-over-IP service offering multiple APIs including Bot API, MTProto API, and Gateway API.

evidence.claim: Telegram offers three kinds of APIs for developers: Bot API, Telegram API (MTProto), and TDLib, plus the Gateway API.
The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.
The Telegram Gateway API uses an access token passed via Authorization Bearer header or access_token parameter.
Community-built Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers exist to bridge Telegram with AI assistants.

notes: Telegram offers multiple APIs including the Bot API (HTTP-based, uses bot tokens), the MTProto API (requires api_id and api_hash for custom clients), and the Gateway API (uses Bearer tokens for verification codes).
